answer: PoA binds every identity to bonded collateral and correlates equivocation evidence across identities. When k coordinated identities sign conflicting statements, the aggregate penalty scales as O(k^2), making aliases progressively more costly. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier amplifies capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation limits recovery of slashed stake. Thus identities named meadow, walnut, or voyage cannot conceal shared control.
